- IsDebuggerPresent - anti-debugging
- VirtualProtect, VirtualQuery - possibly for code modification
- TLS callbacks present
- 19 sections, many with numeric names (/4, /19, /31, etc.) - these are typical of MinGW/GCC compiled binaries with many sections
